purpose: One initialized Iterator CV spread on literal native send. Rewind clears selected target/Iterator CVs; current returns an owning Token before key yields an unknown native parameter. Token, Iterator and selected paused Generator retire in that order before caller-only mapping Error; next and target body stay unexecuted.
source:
<?php
class Token116R {
    function __destruct() {
        global $weakTarget, $weakArgs, $weakToken;
        echo 'TOKEN|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakArgs->get() instanceof Args116R, '|', $weakToken->get() === $this, '|';
    }
}
class Args116R implements Iterator {
    function rewind(): void {
        global $target, $args, $weakTarget, $weakArgs;
        echo 'REWIND|'; $target = null; $args = null;
        echo 'HELD|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakArgs->get() === $this, '|';
    }
    function valid(): bool { echo 'VALID|'; return true; }
    function current(): mixed {
        global $weakToken;
        echo 'CURRENT|'; $token = new Token116R(); $weakToken = WeakReference::create($token); return $token;
    }
    function key(): mixed { echo 'KEY|'; return 'extra'; }
    function next(): void { echo 'BAD-NEXT|'; }
    function __destruct() {
        global $weakTarget, $weakArgs, $weakToken;
        echo 'ITER|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakArgs->get() === $this, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|';
    }
}
function target116R() {
    try { echo 'INIT|'; yield 'head'; echo 'BAD-BODY|'; }
    finally { global $weakTarget, $weakArgs, $weakToken; echo 'FIN|', $weakTarget->get() !== null, '|', $weakArgs->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|'; }
}
function run116R() {
    global $target, $args, $weakTarget, $weakArgs, $weakToken;
    echo 'CALL|';
    try { $target->send(...$args); }
    catch (Error $error) {
        echo 'CATCH|', $error->getMessage(), '|', $weakTarget->get() === null, '|', $weakArgs->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|';
        $trace = $error->getTrace();
        echo 'TRACE|', $trace[0]['function'] === 'run116R', '|', !isset($trace[1]), '|';
    }
}
$target = target116R(); $target->current(); $args = new Args116R();
$weakTarget = WeakReference::create($target); $weakArgs = WeakReference::create($args);
run116R(); echo 'DONE|';
